question: Should OpenClaw land this selectable quick/full PR-template workflow now that the quick template preserves the PR-context headings and hides prompt text from authored sections?
rationale: Source review can verify compatibility with the current PR-context gate, but the shorter contributor template is a workflow-policy choice for maintainers.

options.title: Land the template split

options.title: Request a narrower contract
options.body: Ask for wording or contributor-doc adjustments first if hidden default-template links are not enough guidance.

options.body: Close the PR if maintainers prefer one default template or a different GitHub PR workflow.
